asset_attributions.attribution: Derived from NASA MRO CTX stereo, MOLA-controlled elevation distributed by USGS; generated project visualization and reports
asset_attributions.publication_rights_review: pending; no raw source DEM redistributed

contribution: Built observed-DEM terrain processing, relative site scoring, constrained routing, independent export checks and a unified explorer.

headline_results.denominator: one historical selected-cell route; three candidate routes total
headline_results.limitation: Planar sampled-grid distance; illustrative constraints, not physical mobility validation
headline_results.scope: Jezero CTX reference; 20 m projected analysis grid
headline_results.selection_protocol: Highest-scoring eligible cell in largest traversable component; 1.5 km greedy separation

limitations: Historical reference retains its original dirty revision; it was not regenerated for this handoff.
The compact handoff omits raster outputs; rerunning the full static check requires the private repository's complete reference.
Fresh checker verifies geometry, masks, scores and accumulated costs; independent full-graph shortest-path optimality remains pending.
Terrain scores are ROI-relative and do not establish habitat safety, rover energy or travel time.
Global MOLA is coarse and cannot resolve rover-scale hazards.
Recorded local Docker evidence uses 1 GiB and two CPUs, not validated 512 MiB deployment headroom.
Browser/WebGL interactions, public access and patched live deployment remain unverified.
tested_revision_scope: Fresh static artifact checker only; dirty source identified by hashes
